package.name: threevn_data
package.description:
Collecting datasets from the robot, and keeping them honest.
A dataset is not a folder of images. It is a folder of images plus a claim about where they came from, and the claim is the part that rots. Everything here exists to make the claim checkable: what code recorded it, against which world, with which camera, and which frames may be used together.
ARCHITECTURAL RULE: this package must never depend on Gazebo. It records from ROS topics, which a simulator and a real robot both publish. The LABELS in this phase happen to come from a simulator, which is stated in every manifest rather than assumed.
